title: fix(react, fields): a refused file type reads as the server's reason, not a permission denial
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuAV4YiyoDmRLkH1BexrYX5b)_

Fixes #32684

Item 1 only. Items 2 and 3 of the card were split to #32711 (unique violation names no field, server) and #32712 (upload-link page, server); this PR does not touch them.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：文件字段收到不在 accept 列表里的文件时，表单不再说「您没有权限保存这条记录」，改为显示服务器给出的原因；文件控件在选择或拖放时就提示「不是允许的文件类型」，不再静默上传或静默丢弃。
- 为什么改：报销员上传了错误类型的发票文件，被告知没有权限，只能去找管理员，白跑一趟。
- 风险与回滚：只改了一个判定（带错误码、状态不是 401/403 的 4xx 不再按文字猜成权限拒绝）和文件控件的前置检查；真正的权限拒绝（403、PERMISSION_DENIED、FORBIDDEN、无码的拒绝）仍显示固定的无权限文案。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts`（isPermissionError 新增的那一段）、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/FileField.tsx`（acceptError 与拖放处理）、`.changeset/32684-refused-file-type-reason.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/react/src/utils/error-message.test.ts packages/fields/src/complex-widgets.test.tsx apps/console/src/components/FormPage.refusalText-29019.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件 104 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）对照 diff 复核：只有「带错误码、状态为 400–499 且非 401/403」的拒绝不再按文字猜成权限拒绝，真正的拒绝（403、PERMISSION_DENIED/FORBIDDEN、无码）仍显示固定无权限文案；文件控件在选择、拖放、拍照三条路径都先按 accept 检查。服务端信封没有 field，原因显示在表单横幅与提示里，不标行，这是按 #3821 的有意取舍。新增一个文案键，属于语言包公开面的扩大，已按默认档复核通过。落后 main 16 个提交，已先同步 main 再落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/react` — `isPermissionError`.** A refusal that names both a client-error status other than 401 and 403 **and** a machine code has been classified by its producer, and that code now decides before the text match: it is not a denial. The server answers a file outside a field's `accept` as `400 {"error":"File type 'text/plain' is not permitted by the accept list declared for 'f_file' (…)","code":"ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT"}`, and the old text read matched "not permitted" in it. A 403, a `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `FORBIDDEN` code, and a refusal with no code, no status, a 401 or a 5xx read exactly as before, so ruling B′ on #24914 holds: every real denial keeps the fixed localized line. Every denial the server answers is a 403 (checked: `PermissionDeniedError`, `DelegationScopeViolationError`, the `*_DENIED` / `*_NOT_ACCESSIBLE` / `HOOK_UNSCOPED_DATA_ACCESS` codes in the ledger all declare 403), so no server denial falls into the new branch. The one ledger code that says "not permitted" on a non-403, `422 INSTALL_MODE_NOT_PERMITTED`, is a package's install-mode verdict, not a denial, and now reads as the refusal it is.
- **`@object-ui/fields` — `FileField` and `FileCell`.** The shared upload pipeline checks every pick (file input, drop, native photo pick) against the field's `accept` list the way `service-storage` checks it on save (exact MIME, `type/*`, `.ext` on the file name, any-type wildcard; an entry the file reports nothing to judge against is not a failure). A file outside the list is refused in the widget with `fields.file.typeNotAccepted`, naming the file and the accepted types, and is never uploaded. The drop handler used to filter such files out without a word; it now hands every dropped file to the same check.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`.** New key `fields.file.typeNotAccepted` (`{{name}}`, `{{accept}}`) in all ten hand-written packs, zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`. The de quote-pairing census pin moves 116 → 117 for the new „{{name}}“ span.
- No change to `FormPage.tsx` or the record form renderer (`form.tsx`): both already fall through to the server's 4xx sentence once the refusal stops reading as a denial.

### Where the reason is shown

The card asked for the reason **on the file field**. Measured on a real `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` envelope (below), the wire carries only `error`, `code` and `object` — no `field`, no `details`. `FileConstraintError` keeps `field` as an in-process member only (its own docblock says so). Reading the field name out of the English sentence is the consumer-side guessing objectstack#3821 rules out, so the server's reason is shown in the form banner and toast, and no row is marked. Marking the row needs the server to put `field` on the wire; that is a `packages/**` change outside this claim's surface.

### `isPermissionError` callers (non-test, `ui/**`)

Behaviour changes only for a refusal with a non-401/403 4xx status, a code that is not `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `FORBIDDEN`, and denial-like text. For those, each caller now shows its non-denial branch:

| Caller | Before for such a refusal | After |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` `refusalText` (save) | `form.noPermissionToSave` | the server's 4xx sentence (measured live) |
| `FormPage.tsx` `refusalText` (`Load`) | `form.noPermissionToOpenRecord` | `form.openRecordFailed` |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` (record dialog) | `form.noPermissionToSave` + `console.warn` | the server's sentence via `extractWriteErrorMessage` (measured live) |
| `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx` (reschedule) | `errors.unauthorized` | not-found line or `extractWriteErrorMessage` |
| `packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` (move) | `errors.unauthorized` | `extractWriteErrorMessage` |
| `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx` | `detail.pathStageChangeDenied` | `extractWriteErrorMessage` / `detail.pathStageChangeFailed` |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx` (list read) | `denied` | `unavailable` |
| `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (export) | `view.exportNotPermitted` | the error's message |
| `packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts` | unchanged: it passes `{ code, message }` with no status, so the text match still applies | unchanged |

No caller changes for a 403 or for an uncoded refusal.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.test.ts` — new top-level `describe('isPermissionError — a coded non-denial refusal')`: 400 `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` (code on the error and on `details`, status on `httpStatus` / `status` / `statusCode`) is not a denial; CONTROLs: 403, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `FORBIDDEN` still are; an uncoded 4xx with "permission denied" / "not permitted", a status-less coded error, a row-level-security message, a 401 and a 5xx keep the text match.
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.refusalText-29019.test.tsx` — new top-level `describe('#32684 …')`: the 400 shows the server sentence in banner and toast and marks no row (en and zh); CONTROLs: an uncoded 4xx saying "not permitted" and a 403 that also says it still show `noPermissionToSave`.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/complex-widgets.test.tsx` — new top-level `describe('FileField and FileCell — a type outside accept is refused with a hint')`: pick and drop of a `.txt` show the hint and never upload; a mixed drop uploads only the accepted file; FileCell refuses the same pick; CONTROLs: an accepted `.pdf`, an `image/*` match, no `accept`, and a pick reporting no MIME type against a MIME-only list all upload with no hint. The widget has no paste path (zero `onPaste` / `clipboardData` in `ui/packages/fields/src`), so pick and drop are the two doors.

<details><summary>Runs (head 0bf390c3, tree identical at 47fe9e50)</summary>

- New pins: 3 files, 104/104 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/react/` — 138 files, 1576 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/` — 302 passed, 1 skipped; 4577 passed, 7 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` — 102 files; 1894 passed, 13 skipped (first run red only on the de quote census, 116 vs 117, updated in this PR).
- Caller tests (FormPage loadRefusal/notFound/refusalText, components form-write-error-message and -external-30334, app-shell flowResponse and RecordAttachmentsPanel, kanban markedRefusalToast and rejectedMoveRollback, calendar markedRefusalToast and refusalRemedy-8170, plugin-detail stageRefusalLines-externalWrite-30334): 12 files, 176 passed.
- `type-check` exit 0 for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/console`.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on every changed `.ts`/`.tsx`: 0 errors (pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings only).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran …`: 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; every family exit 0 (includes `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:published-files`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` 5062 passed).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each fix reverted alone through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, then restored; blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- **A — the new `isPermissionError` branch deleted:** 4 red, exactly the targeted pins (`a 400 ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT is not a denial`, `reads the code from details…`, and both FormPage `#32684` cases); every CONTROL stayed green. Restored: blob `db97f45d0e37` == HEAD.
- **B — `acceptError(…) ??` deleted from the upload pipeline:** 4 red (pick, drop, mixed drop, FileCell); the CONTROLs stayed green. Restored: blob `6ca11df1dd43` == HEAD.

The packages are resolved from `src` by the ui vitest alias map, so no rebuild was needed between legs.

</details>

## Verification (live, zh-CN)

Showcase backend (`pnpm dev --fresh`) with `showcase_field_zoo.f_file` temporarily given `accept: ['.pdf','.ofd','.png','.jpg','.jpeg']` (not committed), Console on Vite against it, Playwright with locale zh-CN, record dialog 新建字段动物园.

1. **Pick a `.txt`** — the widget shows 「“not-an-invoice.txt” 不是允许的文件类型（.pdf, .ofd, .png, .jpg, .jpeg）」 and uploads nothing.
   ![after: hint](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/1800e54cc808a065d8123d38041e0f42309f5053/evidence/32684/after-zh-pick-txt-hint.png?raw=true)
2. **Submit with the widget check held off** (so the server refusal is reached) — `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_field_zoo` → `400 {"error":"File type 'text/plain' is not permitted by the accept list declared for 'f_file' (.pdf, .ofd, .png, .jpg, .jpeg)","code":"ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT","object":"showcase_field_zoo"}`. The banner says the server's reason.
   ![after: server reason](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/1800e54cc808a065d8123d38041e0f42309f5053/evidence/32684/after-zh-submit-server-reason.png?raw=true)
3. **Before** (both fixes held off) — the same 400 shows 「您没有权限保存这条记录。」, the card's reading.
   ![before: no permission](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/1800e54cc808a065d8123d38041e0f42309f5053/evidence/32684/before-zh-submit-no-permission.png?raw=true)

The screenshots were committed in 1800e54c and removed in the next commit; the final diff carries none.

## Acceptance notes

- The reason is shown at form level, not on the field: the wire names no field (measured above). Putting `field` on the `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT` envelope is a server change (`service-storage` / the REST passthrough) and is not in this claim's surface.
- The server sentence is English in a zh-CN form (it is the producer's text). Localizing producer text is the program on #32654.
- `ImageField` does not check `accept` on pick either (its picker defaults to `image/*`); it is outside this claim's file surface and is left as it is.
- The FileField drop handler's old matcher compared `file.type` case-sensitively and did not honour `*`; the new check follows the server's matcher.
